threads.body: [Style] These private helpers sit between the `wrap(...)` factory and the constructor. The style guide treats factories and constructors as one construction section, so move both below the constructor with the other methods.

Did you consider handling both cases with the jdk proxy? Since the only thing you do is intercept the `invoke` method I think you could use the same code for the regular an cluster invoker. Only the proxy interfaces would need to be different.
wouldn't bother with this unless it is actually necessary

could use
`${baseVersion("2.7.14").orLatest()}`
so it would also test the latest version
elsewhere where we use `Proxy.newProxyInstance` we don't catch exceptions
perhaps it would be better to inline this

since there are Object methods that would trigger this perhaps it would be better to inline this method into `invoke` and instead of throwing let it fall through to `invokeDelegate` for unhandled Object methods
for correctness might also check that parameter count is 0 and that method returns a boolean
should also handle `InvocationTargetException`, or perhaps use `invokeDelegate` for invoking the method
